rules.sequenceNote: Luke Cage and Jessica Jones are not used before Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.; Nebula, Magneto, and Angel enter the hero roster only after their villain encounters.
rules.scope: 65 scenario matchups through Fear No Evil. Shadowland is excluded because it is upcoming in this sequence.

battle-06.note: Uses the Wrecker, Piledriver, Bulldozer, and Thunderball encounter decks. The printed setup does not use Standard, Expert, or a modular encounter set.

battle-23.note: The Hood pack includes Beasty Boys, Brothers Grimm, Crossfire’s Crew, Mister Hyde, Ransacked Armory, Sinister Syndicate, State of Emergency, Streets of Mayhem, and Wrecking Crew as its modular pool.

battle-29.note: Official pool: Crime, Fantasy, Horror, Sci-Fi, Sitcom, and Western.

battle-30.note: Official pool: Crime, Fantasy, Horror, Sci-Fi, Sitcom, and Western.

battle-31.note: Choose from the MojoMania pool: Crime, Fantasy, Horror, Sci-Fi, Sitcom, and Western.

battle-50.note: Each selected set must contain an Elite Thunderbolt minion. Official pool: Gravitational Pull, Hard Sound, Pale Little Spider, Power of the Atom, Supersonic, and The Leaper.

battle-51.note: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Executive Board and Executive Board Evidence sets are handled separately by the scenario setup.

battle-54.note: Official preconstructed scenario. Main schemes: Cut Off Support → Negative Zone Prison.

battle-55.note: Official preconstructed scenario. Main schemes: S.H.I.E.L.D. Recruits → Hunting Rebel Heroes.

battle-56.note: Official preconstructed scenario. Main schemes: Gathering Support → Secret Avengers.

battle-57.note: Official preconstructed scenario. Main schemes: Open Rebellion → Neighborhood Protectors.

battle-58.note: Official preconstructed scenario. Main schemes: Enforce the Law → Mighty Avengers.

battle-59.note: Official preconstructed scenario. Main schemes: Protect Secret Identities → Expose Overreach.

scenarios.title: Rhino
scenarios.context: Peter gets his classic street-level enemy, while Jen supplies the muscle to stop Rhino without turning the fight into a cosmic event.

scenarios.title: Klaw
scenarios.context: Klaw is fundamentally a Wakandan enemy; T’Challa brings the personal stakes while Storm’s history as Wakanda’s queen gives her a direct reason to defend it.

scenarios.title: Ultron
scenarios.context: Both heroes are tied directly to the Pym legacy and therefore to Ultron’s creation and recurring attacks.

scenarios.title: Risky Business — Norman Osborn / Green Goblin
scenarios.context: Gwen carries the Goblin stakes, while Cindy gives the operation a second New York Spider who can track Norman’s shifting public and criminal identities.

scenarios.title: Mutagen Formula — Green Goblin
scenarios.context: Jessica brings espionage and HYDRA connections; Miles represents the next Spider generation taking on Norman’s escalating madness.

scenarios.title: The Wrecking Crew
scenarios.context: The Crew’s enchanted power belongs directly in Thor’s corner of Marvel, and Hercules turns the encounter into the proper god-tier bar fight it deserves.

scenarios.title: Kang
scenarios.context: Kang has significant Young Avengers connections, giving Hulkling a reason to be here, while Tony handles the Avengers strategy and future-technology problem.

scenarios.title: Crossbones
scenarios.context: Crossbones has personal history with both of Steve’s closest partners; Bucky brings the HYDRA scars while Sam brings modern Captain America fieldcraft.

scenarios.title: Absorbing Man
scenarios.context: Two Avengers heavy hitters meet Crusher Creel at his own level: Hulk matches the raw force while Simon’s ionic body is difficult to neutralize.

scenarios.title: Taskmaster
scenarios.context: Natasha knows Taskmaster’s mercenary world, while Echo turns his copied technique back on him with mimicry of her own.

scenarios.title: Zola
scenarios.context: Vision confronts Zola’s artificial-life experiments while Peni and SP//dr infiltrate and dismantle the laboratory machinery.

scenarios.title: Red Skull
scenarios.context: Steve faces his defining ideological enemy while Fury coordinates the global intelligence operation needed to dismantle HYDRA around him.

scenarios.title: Drang
scenarios.context: Two military veterans with flight and long-range firepower form an ideal planetary defense against a full Badoon invasion.

scenarios.title: The Collector — Infiltrate the Museum
scenarios.context: Rocket and Groot are perfectly suited to breaking into a cosmic museum, stealing the objective and damaging everything nearby.

scenarios.title: The Collector — Escape the Museum
scenarios.context: Drax supplies the force while Agent Venom brings Guardians experience, military discipline and symbiote flexibility to an impossible museum escape.

scenarios.title: Nebula
scenarios.context: Gamora confronts her sister while Star-Lord keeps the Guardians focused on stopping Nebula's assault.

scenarios.title: Ronan the Accuser
scenarios.context: Nebula has every reason to oppose one of Thanos's most dangerous allies, while Nova brings direct experience with interstellar law, war and the Kree.

scenarios.title: Ebony Maw
scenarios.context: Strange and Wanda are the two heroes best equipped to resist Maw’s sorcery, manipulation and mental control.

scenarios.title: Tower Defense — Corvus Glaive & Proxima Midnight
scenarios.context: Shuri coordinates Wakanda’s defense while Ironheart adds a second Wakanda-tested engineering mind and heavy armor against the Black Order.

scenarios.title: Thanos
scenarios.context: Adam is among Thanos’s defining cosmic opponents, while Rocket supplies the Guardians ingenuity and desperate engineering plan needed against the Infinity Stones.

scenarios.title: Hela
scenarios.context: Valkyrie has a direct duty to Asgard’s dead, while Magik knows how to invade, survive and escape a hostile hell dimension.

scenarios.title: Loki
scenarios.context: Thor knows Loki’s schemes by heart, while Hulkling brings Young Avengers experience with shapeshifters, stolen identities and dynastic deception.

scenarios.title: The Hood
scenarios.context: Matt handles the New York criminal empire while Tigra tracks the supernatural fingerprints and underworld network behind Parker Robbins’s operation.

campaigns.note: Revised for variety: New York, street-level, tech and Spider-adjacent heroes; no cosmic outsiders; no hero repeats inside this campaign.

scenarios.title: Sandman
scenarios.context: Two grounded heavy hitters tackle a city-scale physical disaster: Jen protects the civilians while Hercules breaks through Sandman’s shifting mass.

scenarios.title: Venom
scenarios.context: Peter’s symbiote history is too important to ignore, while heroic Flash Thompson confronting a hostile Venom creates a strong mirror matchup.

scenarios.title: Mysterio
scenarios.context: Miles keeps the fight rooted in Spider-Man’s world, while Vision’s synthetic senses provide a believable defense against sensory illusions.

scenarios.title: The Sinister Six
scenarios.context: One Spider keeps the villains personal, while Nova’s speed and aerial control prevent six coordinated threats from swarming the city; Peter Porker’s unpredictability makes their usual counters unreliable.

scenarios.title: Venom Goblin
scenarios.context: Gwen carries the Goblin connection and emotional stakes; Peni supplies specialized Spider technology against Norman’s symbiote-enhanced equipment.

scenarios.title: Magog
scenarios.context: Both heroes are ideal contestants for an absurd televised gladiator match.

scenarios.title: Spiral
scenarios.context: Psylocke has direct mutant-world connections to Spiral, while Domino’s probability manipulation destabilizes Mojoworld’s choreographed chaos.

scenarios.title: Mojo
scenarios.context: Deadpool weaponizes the fourth wall, while Simon understands cameras, performance and ratings well enough to sabotage Mojo from inside the production.

scenarios.title: Sabretooth
scenarios.context: Logan is Sabretooth’s defining rival, while Gambit’s history with Creed and the Marauders gives him a personal reason to help stop him.

scenarios.title: Project Wideawake
scenarios.context: Bishop represents the Sentinel-controlled future, while Jubilee represents the young mutants being hunted in the present.

scenarios.title: Master Mold
scenarios.context: Kitty phases into the Sentinel machinery while Scott shrinks into Master Mold’s production core to sabotage it from the inside.

scenarios.title: Mansion Attack
scenarios.context: Illyana teleports students out of danger while Bobby shields the mansion and contains the Brotherhood’s assault behind barriers of ice.

scenarios.title: Magneto
scenarios.context: Scott and Jean unite X-Men leadership, tactics and telepathy against their team's most defining ideological enemy.

scenarios.title: Morlock Siege — The Marauders
scenarios.context: Storm’s leadership of the Morlocks makes her essential, while Kurt embodies the compassion at the center of their defense.

scenarios.title: On the Run — The Marauders
scenarios.context: This X-Force pairing is built for a mutant manhunt: Laura tracks the hunters while Domino bends the odds against the Marauders’ ambushes.

scenarios.title: Juggernaut
scenarios.context: Colossus provides the iconic powerhouse collision, while Bishop’s future-war tactics and energy absorption give the team a way to redirect Juggernaut’s momentum.

scenarios.title: Mister Sinister
scenarios.context: Gambit has personal history with Sinister and the Marauders, while Magneto refuses to let Sinister weaponize mutant genetics again.

scenarios.title: Stryfe
scenarios.context: Cable faces his clone and defining enemy, while Psylocke supplies the telepathic discipline needed to withstand Stryfe’s psychic assault.

scenarios.title: Unus
scenarios.context: Two generations of X-Men oppose a Brotherhood-linked enforcer: Jubilee keeps the pressure on at range while Iceman controls the battlefield around Unus’s force field.

scenarios.title: The Four Horsemen
scenarios.context: Nightcrawler’s faith and compassion resist Apocalypse’s corruption, while Cyclops coordinates the shifting fight against four very different Horsemen.

scenarios.title: Apocalypse
scenarios.context: Warren confronts the tyrant who transformed him into Death, while Adam brings cosmic insight and power against Apocalypse’s Celestial technology.

scenarios.title: Dark Beast
scenarios.context: Jean counters his psychological and genetic experimentation while Laura has every reason to destroy someone who treats mutants as laboratory material.

scenarios.title: En Sabah Nur
scenarios.context: Both have major stakes in the Age of Apocalypse reality and its mutant resistance.

campaigns.note: Luke Cage and Jessica Jones become eligible after this campaign in the planned play sequence.

scenarios.title: Black Widow — Yelena Belova
scenarios.context: Natasha faces her Red Room counterpart while Fury runs the extraction and counterintelligence operation around their confrontation.

scenarios.title: Batroc
scenarios.context: Sam brings direct Captain America-world history with Batroc, while Hill controls the S.H.I.E.L.D. infiltration and cuts off the mercenary’s escape.

scenarios.title: M.O.D.O.K.
scenarios.context: Two young heroes confront A.I.M.’s weaponized science, with Riri supplying the technical answer and Kamala the adaptable field response.

scenarios.title: Thunderbolts — Citizen V
scenarios.context: Clint brings extensive Thunderbolts history, while Monica’s Avengers leadership exposes the false-hero team and keeps its volatile powers contained.

scenarios.title: Baron Zemo
scenarios.context: Bucky has endured Zemo’s manipulation firsthand, while T’Challa brings the strategic focus and personal resolve to expose the entire infiltration.

scenarios.title: Enchantress
scenarios.context: Valkyrie handles the Asgardian threat while Wanda provides the magical strength needed to resist Amora’s enchantments.

scenarios.title: Loki, God of Lies
scenarios.context: Thor confronts his brother while Doctor Strange cuts through Loki’s sorcery, illusions and reality-bending tricks.

campaigns.note: These are opposing hero-leader scenarios rather than conventional villains.

scenarios.title: Iron Man — Registration
scenarios.context: Steve is Tony’s defining ideological opponent, while Jessica contributes covert resistance skills and divided loyalties.

scenarios.title: Captain Marvel — Registration
scenarios.context: Kamala must challenge her idol while Rogue and Carol bring decades of painful personal history.

scenarios.title: Captain America — Resistance
scenarios.context: Tony leads the registration case while Hill supplies the institutional strategy needed to counter the resistance network.

scenarios.title: Spider-Woman — Resistance
scenarios.context: Carol is Jessica’s closest major heroic relationship, while Luke brings the street-level resistance perspective and firsthand opposition to registration.

scenarios.title: She-Hulk — Registration
scenarios.context: Two longtime Avengers peers challenge Jen without mirroring her directly: Greer can survive the close fight while Janet supplies veteran leadership and de-escalation.

scenarios.title: Vision — Resistance
scenarios.context: Wanda is Vision’s defining relationship, while Pietro is the protective brother who has never been entirely comfortable with him.

scenarios.title: Bullseye
scenarios.context: Echo can match Bullseye’s precision with copied technique of her own, while Clint turns the scenario into the marksman duel it deserves.

scenarios.title: Electro
scenarios.context: Two New York web-warriors confront one of Spider-Man’s foundational villains.

scenarios.title: Hammerhead
scenarios.context: Shuri traces and dismantles the Maggia’s weapons network while Rhodey breaks through Hammerhead’s fortified operation with controlled firepower.

scenarios.title: Purple Man
scenarios.context: Jessica is mandatory because Killgrave is the central source of her trauma; Carol is the close friend most likely to believe her and stand beside her through it.

scenarios.title: Typhoid Mary
scenarios.context: Deadpool brings direct history with Mary, while Wolverine’s senses and healing factor help him survive her misdirection, psychic attacks and fire.

scenarios.title: Kingpin
scenarios.context: Matt is non-negotiable, while Luke completes the Defenders-style pairing against Fisk’s control of New York.
